PRIORITY_INSTRUCTION_FOCUS: FOR THE BLOG ROUTINE ONLY: this batch's 15 guides are the entries at the top of origin/pipeline-config:pipeline/query-queue.json that carry a region field (WB, UP or GEN), priority A, in queue order; skip those already drafted in _drafts/batch13/blog. Use each id as the slug, its query as the basis of the title, its angle as the scope and its verify field as the statutes and cases to confirm from two sources. Answer the question directly in the first paragraph, as on today's date, then statute, forum, time limits and procedure; say where State law differs or is unsettled; link related existing guides by name. Where a State rule, rate or notification cannot be confirmed from an official or reliable source, say it varies and omit the figure. Skip any entry whose subject already exists on origin/main or origin/stage-batch12. practice_area: 'Property & Civil Litigation' or 'Commercial Litigation'. BCI Rule 36: educational only; the page may name the court or forum in the city (for example Calcutta High Court, Gautam Buddha Nagar district court) because the law requires it, but NEVER frame it as 'lawyers/advocates/law firm in <city>', no call to contact the firm, no 'we can help', no fee or consultation wording, no claims of results, experience or clients.
NEWS_UPDATES_NOTE: For news and updates: real, dated rulings and notifications from SCOPE_FROM, none duplicating anything live or staged; educational reporting only (BCI Rule 36). Of every 5 items, at least 4 must meet the REGIONAL FOCUS below. REGIONAL FOCUS (client instruction, 12 Nov 2026): the firm's practice base is Delhi NCR (Delhi first, Noida and Greater Noida in particular) and Kolkata. Prefer topics and rulings from: Delhi High Court and Delhi district courts (Saket, Tis Hazari, Patiala House, Karkardooma, Dwarka, Rohini), DDA, MCD, Delhi RERA, NCLT New Delhi, NCDRC and Delhi consumer commissions; Allahabad High Court, Gautam Buddha Nagar courts, UP RERA, NOIDA/GNIDA; Calcutta High Court, Kolkata courts and tribunals, WBRERA, KMC, NCLT Kolkata, CESTAT Kolkata; and Supreme Court appeals from these. Choose subjects people actually search for when they have a legal doubt (property, tenancy, family, succession, recovery, builder, employment, company and tax disputes, NRI matters). Never use 'lawyers/advocates/law firm in <city>' framing.

STRICT_VERIFICATION: STRICT VERIFICATION (client instruction, 12 Nov 2026): zero tolerance for invented content. Every case name, citation, date, bench, section number, rule, notification, rate, time limit and quote must be confirmed from at least two independent sources opened in this run (court or official site plus a reliable reporter such as Live Law, Bar and Bench, SCC Online blog, Indian Kanoon, India Code, official gazettes). If a fact cannot be confirmed twice, leave it out or say plainly that it varies or is unsettled. Do not cite a case you have not opened. Do not generalise a High Court ruling into a nationwide rule. State the date as on which the law is described. Record every source URL in the draft's sources field. When in doubt, drop the item and write another.
